references.text: Continuation of the laws concerning baldness, describing a man who loses hair from his forehead
Further instructions on how the priest should examine sores on a bald head and when it is to be declared unclean
The cleansing ritual that includes shaving all hair shows the connection between hair and purity in Levitical law
The Nazirite's head must be shaved if he becomes unclean, showing the significance of hair in purity laws
Prophetic text stating that the Lord will shave the head as a judgment, contrasting natural hair loss with divine punishment
